title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 145-147): Grothendieck is building the analytic modular family. A 'Torelli structure' (E,(z1,z2)) is an elliptic curve with an oriented basis z1,z2 of the period lattice H_1(E,Z) inside t_E. Its invariant is tau = z2/z1, a point of the half-plane D^+. On the previous page SL(2,Z) acts on the right on bases by z1' = a z1 + c z2 and z2' = b z1 + d z2. This gives tau o g = (d tau + b)/(c tau + a).

This page lifts that action from the base D^+ to the universal family X_{D^+} = (D^+ x C)/(Z x Z), whose fibre over tau is E_tau = C/(Z + Z tau).

- Each normalized fibre is identified with t_E/H_1 by two coordinatizations: lambda -> lambda z1 (sending 1 -> z1, tau -> z2) and lambda -> lambda z1' (sending 1 -> z1', tau' -> z2').
- Comparing them gives a C-linear map C -> C, multiplication by zeta = z1/z1' = 1/(a + c tau).
- It carries Z + Z tau onto Z + Z tau': zeta(a + c tau) = 1 and zeta(b + d tau) = tau'. Unimodularity of g gives surjectivity.
- Passing to the quotient gives an isomorphism E_tau -> E_{tau o g}.

Grothendieck then substitutes g -> tau_inf(g^{-1}) = (d b; c a), with tau_inf = diag(-1,1); this is formula (13) of the next page. This converts the right action into the usual left Moebius action tau -> (a tau + b)/(c tau + d). The fibre isomorphism E_tau -> E_{g.tau} becomes multiplication by (c tau + d)^{-1}.

Hence formula (14): T_g(tau, z) = (g.tau, z/(c tau + d)). This is the standard action of SL(2,Z) on the universal elliptic curve over the upper half-plane, i.e. the SL2 part of the Jacobi group SL2(Z) x| Z^2.

Checks:
- It is a left action by the cocycle identity j(gh, tau) = j(g, h tau) j(h, tau).
- It descends to the quotient by Z^2, since 1/(c tau + d) = a - c g.tau and tau/(c tau + d) = -b + d g.tau.
- The map g -> (d b; c a) = J g^T J (J antidiagonal) is an anti-automorphism, consistent with turning a right action into a left one.

Purpose: to fix conventions for the SL(2,Z) action on the analytic modular situation, before taking the quotient (the orbifold/stack M_{1,1}) in the notes on moduli of elliptic curves in characteristic not 2.
errors: No mathematical errors found; all formulas check out (zeta = 1/(a+c tau), the action formula (14), the left-action property and compatibility with the lattice).

Minor notational looseness: the multiplication-by-zeta map is drawn as going E_tau -> E_{tau o g}, while the vertical arrow is the change of coordinates lambda -> lambda z1/z1'. This is consistent, but the domain/codomain labels are cramped.
X_{D^+} ≃ (D^+ x C)/(Z x Z) leaves the Z^2 action implicit, namely (tau, z) -> (tau, z + m + n tau).

ideas.what: Right action of SL(2,Z) on period bases inducing tau -> (d tau + b)/(c tau + a), and its conversion to the usual left action via the anti-automorphism g -> tau_inf(g^{-1}) with tau_inf = diag(-1,1)
ideas.modern_name: Modular group action on the upper half-plane; convention switch via transpose-inverse/conjugation

ideas.what: Lift of the action to the universal elliptic curve: T_g(tau, z) = (g.tau, z/(c tau + d))
ideas.modern_name: Action of SL2(Z) (Jacobi group SL2(Z) x| Z^2) on C x H giving the universal elliptic curve over H, and the stack/orbifold M_{1,1}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical; Eichler–Zagier for the Jacobi group formalism

ideas.what: Naming the det = -1 element diag(-1,1) 'tau_infinity', evoking complex conjugation (Frobenius at infinity) acting on the modular situation
ideas.modern_name: Real structure / complex conjugation on the modular tower; extended modular group GL2(Z)

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but entirely classical computation fixing sign and left/right conventions for the SL(2,Z) action on the universal elliptic curve over the upper half-plane. Nothing new beyond the pedagogical bookkeeping and the suggestive notation tau_inf.
transcription_corrections: Line 4 should read 'on note que l'on a une application C-linéaire naturelle'.
The '2' labelling the vertical arrow is likely zeta (the label of the multiplication map lambda -> lambda z1/z1'), not the digit 2.
'E_{tau'[-...-]}' is E_{tau'} with a crossed-out subscript.
